liveScenarios.reason: This adapter invokes the configured provider and database, creates a synthetic identity and processes durable inbound turns; migration checks do not authorize or run that live journey.

limits: The twenty-scenario live journey is not executed; static/parity and rejected-project checks do not establish live model behavior, durable worker completion, persisted cleanup or state assertions.

The existing project opt-in permits the configured database when explicitly matched; it is not replaced by the separate isolated integration environment gate. The 120-request cap counts provider requests, not spend or total database calls, and is preserved rather than expanded into new cost controls.

Fetch interception covers global fetch; it is not a new complete native-network sandbox. Existing future-date and identity checks are retained without asserting broader owner confinement for every database operation.

Case selection may omit prerequisites; selection semantics are unchanged. Original 2031 scenario dates remain fixtures. Cleanup is attempted and verified by the live adapter but is not certified by this offline migration.
